response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS m FROM per), grp AS (SELECT AVG(p.avg_hum) AS g FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_hum > o.m) SELECT p.equipref AS equipment_reference, p.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, p.avg_hum - o.m AS exceeds_overall_avg, p.avg_hum - g.g AS diff_from_group_mean FROM per p, overall o, grp g WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL AND g.g IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_hum > o.m ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC LIMIT 10
